name: Progrex Ventures Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1981, Progrex Ventures Ltd 
is in the business of oil refining and trading[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
PVL, based in Bhopal, operates in manufacturing, trading, and exporting refined oil and soya meal. Though operations have been suspended since FY16, with the sale of its fixed assets, the company continues its business activities through its marketing department and is working to resume trading.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -1.60% over last 3 years.
